description:
[Universal CEN/EN 16931 & Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 validator. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits structured e-invoices against CEN/EN 16931 semantic standards and OpenPeppol UBL 2.1 Schematron rules, calculating tax subtotals, line extension totals, and payable amounts with decimal.js precision.
Usage: Use this tool to validate cross-border e-invoices before dispatching to Peppol Access Points or European buyers.
Returns: JSON object with { invoiceNumber: string, isCenEn16931Compliant: boolean, isPeppolBis3Compliant: boolean, validationStatus: string, financialTotals: object, vatSubtotals: array, violationsFound: array }.

allowanceChargeAmountEur.description: Optional surcharge or document-level discount in EUR

buyerReferenceOrOrderNumber.description: Buyer reference or purchase order number (cbc:BuyerReference)

dueDateIso.description: Payment due date in YYYY-MM-DD format

vatRatePercent.description: VAT tax rate percentage applicable to line item

issueDateIso.description: Invoice issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format

receiverVatId.description: Buyer statutory VAT number with country prefix

senderEndpointId.description: Seller Peppol Electronic Address Scheme (EAS) identifier (e.g. 0201:IT01234567890)

senderVatId.description: Seller statutory VAT number with country prefix (e.g. IT01234567890)

name: universal_peppol_bis3_validator
